recipes.name: Soft Steamed Idli
recipes.description: Pillowy fermented rice-and-lentil cakes steamed until springy — a Tamil breakfast staple with coconut chutney.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Batter needs overnight ferment (not counted in prep).

steps.title: Soak
steps.instruction: Rinse idli rice and urad dal separately. Soak rice 4–6 hours; soak dal with fenugreek 3–4 hours.

steps.title: Grind
steps.instruction: Grind dal with a little water to a fluffy paste. Grind rice to a slightly coarse batter. Mix both with salt.

steps.title: Ferment
steps.instruction: Cover and ferment 8–12 hours in a warm spot until batter rises and smells lightly tangy.

steps.title: Steam
steps.instruction: Grease idli moulds, pour batter three-quarters full, and steam 10–12 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Rest 2 minutes, unmould with a wet spoon, and serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Crispy Plain Dosa
recipes.description: Thin, lacy fermented crepes cooked on a hot tawa until golden and crisp at the edges.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Same batter base as idli, thinned for spreading.

steps.title: Soak and grind
steps.instruction: Soak rice, urad, chana dal, and fenugreek 4–5 hours. Grind to a smooth batter; mix salt and ferment overnight.

steps.title: Thin batter
steps.instruction: Stir fermented batter and thin with water to pouring cream consistency.

steps.title: Heat tawa
steps.instruction: Heat a cast-iron or nonstick tawa until a water droplet sizzles and dances.

steps.title: Spread
steps.instruction: Pour a ladle of batter in the centre and quickly spiral outward into a thin circle.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.instruction: Drizzle oil around the edges. Cook until the underside is deep golden; fold and serve with chutney and potato masala.

recipes.name: Classic Tomato Sambar
recipes.description: Tangy toor-dal stew with tomato, drumstick, and a roasted spice mix — the everyday gravy of South Indian meals.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Cook dal
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric and 2.5 cups water until soft. Mash lightly.

steps.title: Simmer vegetables
steps.instruction: In a pot, simmer onion, tomato, and drumstick with tamarind paste, salt, and 1.5 cups water until tender.

steps.title: Add spice
steps.instruction: Stir in sambar powder and cook 3–4 minutes so the raw spice smell fades.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add mashed dal, adjust consistency with water, and simmer 8–10 minutes.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, red chilli, and curry leaves. Pour over sambar, garnish with coriander, and serve.

recipes.name: Pepper Rasam
recipes.description: Thin, peppery tamarind broth finished with a crackling temper — light soup for rice or sipping when under the weather.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Crush spices
steps.instruction: Coarsely crush pepper, cumin, and garlic together.

steps.title: Build broth
steps.instruction: In a pot combine crushed spices, chopped tomato, tamarind, turmeric, rasam powder, salt, and water. Bring to a gentle boil.

steps.title: Add dal
steps.instruction: Stir in mashed dal and simmer until foam rises and the broth smells fragrant, about 8 minutes. Do not overboil.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat ghee; crackle mustard and curry leaves. Pour over rasam, add coriander, and serve with hot rice.

recipes.name: Beans Poriyal
recipes.description: Finely chopped green beans sautéed with mustard, urad dal, and fresh coconut — a dry Tamil side dish.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Prep beans
steps.instruction: Trim and finely chop green beans into small pieces.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, then fry urad dal until golden. Add red chilli, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Cook beans
steps.instruction: Add beans, turmeric, and salt. Sprinkle 2–3 tbsp water, cover, and cook on medium-low until tender-crisp, 8–10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Uncover, evaporate excess moisture, fold in grated coconut, and serve warm with rice and sambar.

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetable Avial
recipes.description: Kerala-style mixed vegetables simmered in coconut-yogurt gravy with cumin and curry leaves.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Use thick slightly sour yogurt.

steps.title: Cook vegetables
steps.instruction: Simmer mixed vegetables with turmeric, salt, and just enough water until almost tender but not mushy.

steps.title: Grind paste
steps.instruction: Grind coconut, cumin, and green chilli to a coarse paste with a splash of water.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add coconut paste to the vegetables and simmer 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Yogurt
steps.instruction: Lower heat. Whisk yogurt smooth and stir in; warm gently without boiling so it does not split.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Drizzle coconut oil, add curry leaves, rest 5 minutes, and serve with rice or adai.

recipes.name: Lemon Rice
recipes.description: Fluffy leftover rice brightened with lemon, turmeric, peanuts, and a classic South Indian temper.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Best with cooled day-old rice.

steps.title: Fluff rice
steps.instruction: Spread cooked rice and cool so grains separate. Mix lemon juice and turmeric in a small bowl.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard. Fry urad, chana dal, and peanuts until golden. Add chillies, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Season
steps.instruction: Lower heat, pour in lemon-turmeric mix, and stir 10 seconds.

steps.title: Toss
steps.instruction: Add rice and salt; toss gently until evenly yellow. Rest 5 minutes and serve with yogurt or papad.

recipes.name: Coconut Chutney
recipes.description: Fresh coconut ground with green chilli and ginger, finished with a mustard-curry leaf temper — the classic idli-dosa dip.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Grind
steps.instruction: Blend coconut, roasted chana, green chilli, ginger, salt, and water to a slightly coarse paste.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.instruction: Transfer to a bowl; thin with a splash of water if needed for dipping consistency.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry urad dal, red chilli, and curry leaves. Pour over chutney and stir.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve immediately with idli, dosa, or vada.

recipes.name: Tomato Chutney
recipes.description: Tangy onion-tomato chutney with a mild spice base — a bright companion for dosa and upma.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Fry base
steps.instruction: Heat 1.5 tbsp oil; fry chana and urad dal until golden. Add red chilli, garlic, and onion; sauté until soft.

steps.title: Cook tomato
steps.instruction: Add chopped tomato, salt, and tamarind. Cook until pulpy and oil separates slightly.

steps.title: Blend
steps.instruction: Cool slightly and grind to a smooth chutney; adjust salt.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat remaining oil; crackle mustard and curry leaves. Pour over chutney and serve.

recipes.name: Vegetable Upma
recipes.description: Savory semolina porridge with mixed vegetables and a mustard-cashew temper — quick South Indian breakfast.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Rava is wheat-based (not gluten-free).

steps.title: Roast rava
steps.instruction: Dry-roast semolina on medium heat until fragrant and lightly coloured; set aside.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry dals and cashews. Add chilli, ginger, curry leaves, then onion.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.instruction: Add carrot and peas; sauté 2 minutes. Pour in water and salt; bring to a boil.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Lower heat and slowly rain in roasted rava while stirring to avoid lumps.

steps.title: Steam
steps.instruction: Cover and cook 3–4 minutes until fluffy. Finish with lemon juice and serve hot.

recipes.name: Medu Vada
recipes.description: Crisp-fried urad dal doughnuts with soft centres — a classic tiffin with coconut chutney and sambar.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Soak time not counted in prep.

steps.title: Soak
steps.instruction: Rinse and soak urad dal 3–4 hours. Drain well.

steps.title: Grind
steps.instruction: Grind dal with almost no water to a thick fluffy paste. Mix in rice flour, chilli, ginger, pepper, curry leaves, onion, and salt.

steps.title: Shape
steps.instruction: Wet hands, shape doughnuts with a hole in the centre on a banana leaf or plastic sheet.

steps.title: Fry
steps.instruction: Heat oil to medium-hot. Slide in vadas and fry, flipping, until deep golden and crisp, 4–5 minutes each batch.

steps.title: Drain
steps.instruction: Drain on paper towels and serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.

recipes.name: Ven Pongal
recipes.description: Comforting savory rice-and-moong porridge enriched with ghee, pepper, cumin, and cashews.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Roast dal
steps.instruction: Dry-roast moong dal lightly until aromatic. Rinse with rice.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook rice and dal with water and salt until soft and porridge-like (about 4–5 whistles).

steps.title: Mash
steps.instruction: Open cooker, mash gently, and keep warm. Add a splash of hot water if too thick.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat ghee; fry cashews golden. Add pepper, cumin, ginger, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Pour tempering over pongal, mix well, and serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

recipes.name: Curd Rice
recipes.description: Cool yogurt rice tempered with mustard, ginger, and green chilli — the soothing close to a spicy South Indian meal.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Use slightly warm rice so yogurt blends smoothly.

steps.title: Mash rice
steps.instruction: Mash warm cooked rice lightly. Mix with yogurt, milk, and salt to a creamy loose consistency.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry urad dal, then add chilli, ginger, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Pour tempering over curd rice and mix. Chill 15–20 minutes if desired.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.instruction: Top with pomegranate if using and serve with pickle or fried chillies.

recipes.name: Potato Masala
recipes.description: Soft spiced potato filling with onion and curry leaves — the classic stuffing for masala dosa.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Boil potatoes
steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until tender, peel, and roughly mash leaving some chunks.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry dals golden. Add chilli, ginger, and curry leaves.

steps.title: Onion
steps.instruction: Sauté sliced onion until soft and translucent. Add turmeric.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add mashed potato, salt, and a splash of water. Cook 3–4 minutes, folding gently.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Stir in coriander and lemon juice. Use as dosa filling or as a dry side.

recipes.name: Adai
recipes.description: Protein-rich mixed-lentil and rice pancakes, thicker than dosa, with onion and curry leaves in the batter.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. No long fermentation required.

steps.title: Soak
steps.instruction: Soak rice and dals together with red chilli and fennel for 2–3 hours.

steps.title: Grind
steps.instruction: Grind to a slightly coarse thick batter. Mix salt, onion, and curry leaves. Rest 20 minutes.

steps.title: Spread
steps.instruction: Heat tawa; pour a ladle and spread into a thick pancake with a few holes for crisp edges.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Drizzle oil; cook both sides until golden and crisp at the rim.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot with avocado or jaggery, or with avial and coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Keerai Kootu
recipes.description: Spinach simmered with moong dal and ground coconut-cumin paste — a mild Tamil kootu for rice meals.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Cook dal
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook moong dal with turmeric and 1.5 cups water until soft.

steps.title: Wilt greens
steps.instruction: Add chopped spinach to the dal and cook 3–4 minutes until wilted.

steps.title: Coconut paste
steps.instruction: Grind coconut, cumin, and green chilli. Stir into the pot with salt; simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry urad dal, red chilli, and curry leaves. Pour over kootu and serve.

recipes.name: Tamarind Rice
recipes.description: Tangy puliyodarai-style rice with roasted spice paste, peanuts, and sesame — excellent for lunchboxes.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Roast spice
steps.instruction: Dry-roast coriander, chana dal, sesame, fenugreek, and 2 red chillies until fragrant. Cool and grind coarse.

steps.title: Tamarind base
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil; add tamarind paste, turmeric, salt, jaggery, and 0.5 cup water. Simmer until thick.

steps.title: Spice paste
steps.instruction: Stir in ground spice powder and cook 2 minutes to a pulpy paste.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: In remaining oil, crackle mustard, fry peanuts, remaining chillies, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Mix rice
steps.instruction: Combine tempering and tamarind paste with cooled rice. Toss gently and rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Coconut Rice
recipes.description: Fragrant rice tossed with fresh coconut, green chilli, and a crunchy lentil-cashew temper.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Prep rice
steps.instruction: Fluff cooled cooked rice so grains are separate.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat coconut oil; crackle mustard, fry dals and cashews until golden. Add chillies, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Toast coconut
steps.instruction: Add grated coconut and sauté 1–2 minutes until just fragrant — do not brown deeply.

steps.title: Toss
steps.instruction: Add rice and salt; toss gently. Serve with potato fry or yogurt.

recipes.name: Mor Kuzhambu
recipes.description: Mild yogurt curry with ash gourd and a coconut-cumin-chilli paste — a Tamil classic for rice.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Do not boil after adding yogurt.

steps.title: Cook vegetable
steps.instruction: Simmer ash gourd with turmeric, salt, and a little water until just tender.

steps.title: Grind paste
steps.instruction: Grind coconut, cumin, green chilli, and soaked raw rice to a smooth paste.

steps.title: Yogurt mix
steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt with the coconut paste until smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Lower heat under the vegetable. Stir in yogurt mixture and warm gently until it just begins to froth — do not boil.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard and fenugreek, add red chilli and curry leaves. Pour over kuzhambu and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Beetroot Poriyal
recipes.description: Sweet grated beetroot stir-fried with mustard temper and coconut — a colourful everyday side.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry urad dal, red chilli, curry leaves, and asafoetida.

steps.title: Cook beet
steps.instruction: Add grated beetroot and salt. Cover and cook on medium-low 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Dry
steps.instruction: Uncover and cook off excess moisture until beet is tender but not mushy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fold in coconut, cook 1 minute, and serve with rice and rasam.

recipes.name: Rava Idli
recipes.description: Quick semolina steamed cakes with yogurt, cashews, and temper — no overnight ferment needed.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Semolina contains gluten.

ingredients.name: eno fruit salt or baking soda

steps.title: Roast and temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil; crackle mustard, fry chana dal and cashews. Add chilli, ginger, and curry leaves. Stir in semolina and roast 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Batter
steps.instruction: Cool slightly. Mix yogurt, water, salt, and carrot into the rava. Rest 15–20 minutes; batter should be thick-pourable.

steps.title: Leaven
steps.instruction: Just before steaming, stir in eno or baking soda until the batter turns light and foamy.

steps.title: Steam
steps.instruction: Grease moulds, fill, and steam 10–12 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Unmould and serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.

recipes.name: South Indian Filter Coffee
recipes.description: Strong decoction from a traditional filter, frothed with hot milk and a touch of sugar.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Decoction drip time varies by grind.

steps.title: Load filter
steps.instruction: Place coffee powder in the upper chamber of a South Indian filter. Tamp lightly.

steps.title: Brew
steps.instruction: Pour hot water over the powder, cover, and let decoction drip 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Heat milk
steps.instruction: Warm milk until steaming hot but not boiled over.

steps.title: Froth
steps.instruction: In a tumbler, mix 2–3 tbsp decoction with sugar. Add hot milk and pour between tumbler and davara until frothy. Serve immediately.
